notes:
Templates: Host Discovery, Basic Network Scan, Advanced Scan, Advanced Dynamic, Malware, Mobile Device, Web Application Tests, Credentialed Patch Audit, Badlock/Shellshock/DROWN detection.
Credentialed auth - Windows: Password, Kerberos, LM/NTLM hash. Linux: Password, Public Key, Certificate, Kerberos. Also DB (Oracle/PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL/...) and service (FTP/HTTP/IMAP/IPMI/Telnet).
Plugin severities: Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info (plugins written in NASL). Safe checks recommended. Key Nessus scan types: Basic Network Scan (unauthenticated, broad), Advanced Scan (full control + credentials), Web Application Tests (web-focused), Credentialed Patch Audit (compliance-focused). Authenticated scans find significantly more findings — always use credentials when in scope. Also covered in: CPTS Ch06 (Vulnerability Assessment).

recommended.note: Exam-legal detection: Nessus is banned on OSCP, use nmap NSE vuln scripts.
